craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha of attainment — verbs are all attainments. Withdrawn-tending; face-to-face close (sākṣāt enacted). Rejected: (a) face-to-face→directly → killed: face keeps body. Read aloud: DRAWN-back FROM-all-THOUGHT … AT-tain-IT face-TO-face.

lines: Drawn back from all thought — I, tending thought-free own-knowing —
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃhṛtya sarvataś cintām [aha]m ity anuśīlayan | avikalpāṃ svasaṃvittiṃ pratyakṣāṃ pratipadyate
